# Project Phoenix v45.0 — Global Situation 2: The Little Ice Age & General Crisis (1570-1715).
# Pure native EU5 1.4.9 Interactive Situation (`is_data_map = yes`, live `oe_v45_lia_resilience` 0..100).
# Generated by gen_v450_world_situations.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_v45_little_ice_age = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	hint_tag = hint_oe_sit_v45_little_ice_age

	can_start = {
		current_year >= 1570
		current_year <= 1715
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v45_lia_ended }
		any_country = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			num_locations >= 12
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					continent = continent:europe
					continent = continent:asia
					sub_continent = sub_continent:north_america
				}
			}
		}
	}

	visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
		OR = {
			is_ai = no
			is_great_power = yes
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					continent = continent:europe
					continent = continent:asia
					sub_continent = sub_continent:north_america
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Agrarian Resilience & Granary Mastery (oe_v45_lia_resilience >= 85)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v45_lia_end_resilient_recovery"
		desc = "oe_v45_lia_end_resilient_recovery_desc"
		trigger = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v45_lia_resilience }
				var:oe_v45_lia_resilience >= 85
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_ended value = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v45_lia_participant
					}
				}
				add_stability = 6
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_mod_lia_resilient_recovery years = 30 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Scars of the Seventeenth-Century Crisis (post-1700 low resilience)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v45_lia_end_hard_thaw"
		desc = "oe_v45_lia_end_hard_thaw_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1700
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v45_lia_resilience }
				var:oe_v45_lia_resilience < 40
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_ended value = 2 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v45_lia_participant
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_mod_lia_hard_thaw years = 25 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 3: Return of the Sun (1715 natural solar recovery)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v45_lia_end_solar_return"
		desc = "oe_v45_lia_end_solar_return_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1715
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_ended value = 3 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v45_lia_participant
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_mod_lia_hard_thaw years = 20 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_started value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_resilience value = 30 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_ws_7_seen }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ws_7_seen value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_participant value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ws_ev_cd value = 1 days = 420 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v45_ws.7
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_lia_resilience } } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_resilience value = 30 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1615
				current_year <= 1675
				var:oe_v45_lia_resilience > 15
				NOT = {
					any_country = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						has_country_modifier = oe_v45_mod_hardy_crops
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_resilience add = -0.15 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_v45_lia_resilience < 78
				any_country = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						has_country_modifier = oe_v45_mod_relief_granaries
						has_country_modifier = oe_v45_mod_hardy_crops
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_resilience add = 0.25 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_lia_resilience > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_resilience value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_lia_resilience < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_resilience value = 0 } }
	}

	on_ended = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v45_lia_ended } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_lia_ended value = 3 }
		}
	}

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					climate = arctic
					climate = subpolar
					climate = continental
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v45_lia_map_severe_frost_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					climate = cold_arid
					climate = cold_semi_arid
					climate = oceanic
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v45_lia_map_temperate_stress_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					climate = mediterranean
					climate = subtropical
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v45_lia_map_grain_buffer_tt
		}
	}

	is_data_map = yes
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					climate = arctic
					climate = subpolar
					climate = continental
				}
			}
			value = blue_light
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					climate = cold_arid
					climate = cold_semi_arid
					climate = oceanic
				}
			}
			value = blue_mid
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					climate = mediterranean
					climate = subtropical
				}
			}
			value = brown_light
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v45_lia_legend_severe_frost"
		color = rgb { 104 166 224 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v45_lia_legend_temperate_stress"
		color = rgb { 86 122 168 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v45_lia_legend_grain_buffer"
		color = rgb { 196 154 78 }
	}
}
